categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server initialization in src/httpserver.cpp and RPC bind tests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a security vulnerability where bitcoind fails open on IPv4 bind failures and leaks RPC cookie credentials to rogue local processes. According to the problem description, when IPv4 bind fails but IPv6 succeeds, bitcoind still writes out the RPC cookie, causing default bitcoin-cli invocations to send plaintext credentials directly to whatever local process occupies the IPv4 port.
